name: Basic Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 190C/375F and line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
In another bowl whisk eggs, milk and oil.
Fold wet into dry until just combined — lumpy is fine; don't overmix.
Bake 18-22 min until risen and a skewer comes out clean.
notes: A blank-canvas recipe: fold in ~150 g blueberries, chocolate chips, or add lemon zest. Overmixing makes them tough.
